meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你设置或检查记忆的云端同步。它会读取同步状态、要求你提供连接信息、写入设置并重启验证，最后报告设备ID、待同步数量等。
howto.when: 当你说“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”、“云备份”、“同步状态”，或要求备份/同步记忆数据库时触发。

say.note: Claude 会要求你提供 cmem.ai 的连接信息。

say.text: 检查我的记忆同步状态。
say.note: Claude 会查询当前同步状态并报告。
Claude 会引导你完成同步设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up or check cloud sync of your memories. It reads sync status, asks for connection details, writes settings, restarts, and reports device ID, pending counts, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or ask to back up/sync your memory database.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync for my memories.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your cmem.ai connection details.
Claude will query and report the current sync status.

say_en.text: Back up my memories to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the sync setup.
